en.title: Flap Boost
en.subtitle: One shared BNB Vault per token. Add burn, distribution or retention operations to the same pool.
en.labels.signalPulseHint: Visualizes automation activity, not price data.
en.labels.randomHoldersPerRound: up to {count} random holders per round
en.workflow.createDetail: Set the CA and fixed rules
en.workflow.fundDetail: All operations for this token use one BNB pool
en.workflow.scheduleDetail: Enough BNB queues the next round
en.sections.addOperation: Add an operation for this token
en.modes.fixedBnbDetail: Use the same BNB amount in every completed buyback.
en.modes.tokenAmountDetail: Buy a target token quantity in each round.
en.modes.balanceShareDetail: Use a fixed percentage of the available BNB balance.
en.placeholders.fixedRecipients: One 0x address per line, up to 5
en.states.wrongNetwork: Switch to {chain} before sending a transaction.
en.states.waitingCallbackHint: The transaction is being confirmed. The Vault continues automatically once the on-chain callback completes.
en.states.factoryUnavailable: The bound Factory does not provide the new shared-Vault interface, or cannot be reached. No tasks have been deleted. Bind the new deployment before creating operations.
en.states.actionsUnavailable: Actions wait for Flap market data to become available.
en.states.connectWalletToRead: Connect your wallet to load its operations. No operation data has been read yet.
en.states.loadingTasks: Loading operations from the current Factory…
en.states.taskReadFailed: Could not read operations from the current Factory; the count is not zero.
en.states.noTasksAtFactory: This wallet has no operations in the current Factory. Older Factory tasks are not deleted.
en.states.readStateHint: An unreadable Factory or disconnected wallet is not the same as zero on-chain operations.
en.states.noTokenOperations: No operation for this token yet.
en.states.rulesQueued: Changes are queued. The already-booked round will finish under its original rules; the new rules take effect afterward.
en.states.scheduledHint: The next round has been scheduled and is waiting for Trigger.
en.states.readyToSchedule: When the task has enough BNB, it schedules the next round automatically.
en.states.startHint: Funding only deposits BNB. The owner checks the balance and starts the first buyback explicitly.
en.states.pausedHint: Automation is paused. Resume it when you are ready to continue.
en.states.closedHint: This task is closed. Its remaining BNB has been returned to the owner.
en.help.taskList: Operations for the same token share one Vault BNB balance and one Trigger queue.
en.help.tokenWorkspace: Every operation buys this token with BNB; choose what happens to the bought tokens: burn, distribute, or retain. You can run several operations for one CA.
en.help.separateOperationFunds: One token has one Vault. All its operations draw from the same BNB pool; the first start fee is charged only once for that Vault. Due operations run in order, and an unaffordable next operation waits for more funding.
en.help.existingTokenCreate: This token CA is fixed for the new operation. Its Portal quote is refreshed before you create it.
en.help.operation.distribute: Buy tokens and distribute them through fixed addresses or random holders.
en.help.operation.retain: Buy tokens and send them to one wallet you choose.
en.help.noTokenOperations: Choose an operation above. Fund the token Vault once, then explicitly start each operation after checking its balance.
en.help.noTasks: Create and fund a task, then click Check funds & start. The first buyback runs in that start transaction; later rounds use Trigger.
en.help.bnbPerRound: The exact BNB used for every buyback round.
en.help.buybackMode: Each method maps to its own Factory method and is fixed in the task contract at creation.
en.help.tokenAmountPerRound: Buy at least this number of tokens. The BNB ceiling is never exceeded.
en.help.maxBnbForToken: Required ceiling for this method; it bounds the exact-input quote and swap.
en.help.balancePercentage: The first round uses this percentage after the one-time start fee; later rounds use the balance after the Trigger fee.
en.help.maxBnbForPercentage: Optional hard ceiling. Leave empty to use only the percentage rule.
en.help.interval: At least one minute between successful buybacks.
en.help.retain: Tokens from every completed buyback go to this address.
en.help.recipients: One recipient per line, up to five. This only increases the on-chain holder count if a receiving address had zero tokens before distribution; it does not find new holders automatically.
en.help.distributionMode: Choose fixed addresses you enter, or random holder addresses generated for every completed round.
en.help.randomHolders: Each round splits the output across up to 20 generated pseudo-random addresses. These are not user-controlled wallets and their tokens cannot be recovered through this app.
en.help.taskOverview: The owner can edit the per-round amount, interval, and token handling. The buyback method and token CA stay fixed.
en.help.editRules: Update this task without moving its funds. If a round is already booked, changes take effect after it finishes.
en.help.editOutputRisk: The task owner can redirect tokens from future rounds to a new recipient. Anyone funding this task must trust its owner.
en.help.editModeFixed: This execution method is fixed for the lifetime of the task.
en.help.firstDirect: Funding alone does not trade or book a Trigger. After checking the balance, the owner clicks Check funds & start to execute the first buyback, then book only the next round.
en.errors.targetToken: Enter a valid target-token contract address.
en.errors.loadTokenFirst: Load a valid token CA first so the token amount uses the right decimals.
en.errors.priceFloor: This CA does not currently have a usable Flap quote, so a buyback task cannot be created.
en.errors.targetLookup: This CA could not be read as a token.
en.errors.interval: The interval must be at least one minute.
en.errors.fixedRecipients: Enter one to five distinct valid addresses.
en.errors.randomHolders: Enter a whole number from 1 to 20.
en.errors.funding: Enter a valid BNB funding amount.
en.errors.startFunds: Only the task owner can start it, and its balance must cover the first buyback plus the one-time start fee.
en.errors.factoryRead: The Factory task list could not be read. Confirm that this Mini App is using the new Factory on the active chain.
en.errors.simulation: Pre-transaction check failed. Verify the task state, BNB amount, and token CA.
en.errors.tx: Transaction failed. Check the wallet prompt and the on-chain task state.
en.messages.taskFunded: BNB has been added to the shared token Vault.
en.messages.taskClosed: Operation closed. Shared Vault BNB remains available to the other operations and can be withdrawn by the owner.
en.messages.checked: Task funds checked and scheduling retried.
en.messages.started: First buyback executed; the next round is booked if funds remain.

zh.title: Flap Boost
zh.subtitle: 每个代币一个共享 BNB 金库；销毁、分发和留存都在同一资金池下运行。
zh.labels.totalBnb: 共享 Vault BNB 总余额
zh.labels.signalPulseHint: 仅表示自动执行活动，不代表价格数据。
zh.labels.randomHolderCount: 每轮随机增加持有人数
zh.labels.randomHoldersPerRound: 每轮最多随机增加 {count} 个持有人
zh.labels.funding: 为该代币共享 Vault 充值
zh.workflow.createDetail: 设置 CA 与固定回购规则
zh.workflow.fundDetail: 同一代币的全部操作共享这笔 BNB
zh.workflow.scheduleDetail: BNB 足够时自动预约下一轮
zh.workflow.outputDetail: 销毁、留存或固定地址分发
zh.sections.taskFunds: 共享 Vault BNB 资金
zh.modes.fixedBnbDetail: 每一轮使用相同数量的 BNB 完成回购。
zh.modes.tokenAmountDetail: 每一轮以指定的目标代币数量为回购目标。
zh.modes.balanceShareDetail: 每一轮按任务当前可用 BNB 的固定比例执行。
zh.placeholders.targetToken: 输入 0x 代币合约地址
zh.placeholders.fixedRecipients: 每行一个 0x 地址，最多 5 个
zh.states.wrongNetwork: 请先切换到 {chain} 再发送交易。
zh.states.waitingCallback: 正在等待链上确认与回调
zh.states.waitingCallbackHint: 交易确认期间请不要关闭页面；链上回调完成后会自动刷新任务状态。
zh.states.factoryUnavailable: 当前绑定的 Factory 不支持新版共享 Vault 接口，或暂时无法读取。旧任务并未被删除；创建新操作前须绑定新部署地址。
zh.states.actionsUnavailable: 等待 Flap 市场数据可用后才能操作。
zh.states.connectWalletToRead: 请先连接钱包以读取操作；当前尚未读取链上任务数据。
zh.states.loadingTasks: 正在从当前 Factory 读取操作…
zh.states.taskReadFailed: 当前 Factory 的任务读取失败，不能把数量当成 0。
zh.states.noTasksAtFactory: 此钱包在当前 Factory 下没有操作；旧 Factory 中的任务并未被删除。
zh.states.readStateHint: 钱包未连接或 Factory 读取失败，不等于链上操作数量为零。
zh.states.rulesQueued: 修改已排队：当前已预约的一轮仍按原规则执行，结束后新规则才生效。
zh.states.scheduledHint: 下一轮已预约，等待 Trigger 执行。
zh.states.readyToSchedule: 余额满足条件后，系统会自动预约下一轮。
zh.states.startHint: 充值只入账。创建者核对余额后，点击“检查余额并启动”才执行首轮回购。
zh.states.pausedHint: 自动执行已暂停，恢复后才会继续预约。
zh.states.closedHint: 任务已关闭，剩余 BNB 已退回任务所有者。
zh.help.taskList: 同一代币的多个操作共用一个 Vault 余额和一条 Trigger 队列。
zh.help.tokenWorkspace: 每种操作都会用 BNB 回购这个代币，区别是买入后销毁、分发还是留存。同一 CA 可以同时运行多条操作。
zh.help.separateOperationFunds: 一个代币对应一个 Vault，全部操作共用 BNB；首次启动费对这个 Vault 只收一次。操作按到期顺序执行，下一个余额不足时等待充值。
zh.help.existingTokenCreate: 新操作沿用当前代币 CA；创建前会重新读取 Portal 报价。
zh.help.operation.distribute: 买入代币后，可选固定地址分发或随机增加持有人。
zh.help.operation.retain: 买入代币后转入一个指定钱包。
zh.help.noTokenOperations: 在上方创建操作。向该代币金库充值后，核对余额并逐个启动操作。
zh.help.noTasks: 先创建任务并充值，再点击“检查余额并启动”。首轮在启动交易里直接回购，后续轮次才使用 Trigger。
zh.help.bnbPerRound: 每一轮回购固定使用的 BNB 数量。
zh.help.buybackMode: 三种方式分别调用 Factory 的链上创建方法；创建后不能切换回购方式。
zh.help.tokenAmountPerRound: 每轮至少买入此数量代币；实际使用 BNB 不会超过你设置的上限。
zh.help.maxBnbForToken: 此方式必须填写，用于限制询价和实际交换最多可用的 BNB。
zh.help.balancePercentage: 首轮扣除一次性启动费后按余额比例回购；后续轮次先支付 Trigger 费，再按剩余余额比例计算。
zh.help.maxBnbForPercentage: 可选的单轮硬上限；留空则只按余额比例计算。
zh.help.interval: 两次成功回购之间至少间隔 1 分钟。
zh.help.retain: 每轮回购所得代币都会转入这个地址。
zh.help.recipients: 每行一个接收地址，最多 5 个。只有接收前余额为零的地址收到代币后，链上持有人数才可能增加；合约不会自动寻找新持有人。
zh.help.distributionMode: 固定地址由你填写；随机增加持有人会在每次回购完成时生成一批随机地址。
zh.help.randomHolders: 每轮会把代币平均分给最多 20 个随机生成的地址。这些不是用户可控制的钱包，代币无法通过本应用找回；20 人上限用于保证 Trigger 回调稳定执行。
zh.help.taskOverview: 可修改每轮金额、间隔和买入后处理；回购方式与代币 CA 固定。
zh.help.editRules: 修改不会转移任务资金；如当前一轮已预约，新规则会在该轮结束后生效。
zh.help.editOutputRisk: 任务创建者可修改以后轮次的收币地址。给此任务充值的人需要信任任务创建者。
zh.help.editModeFixed: 任务创建时选定的回购方式不可切换。
zh.help.firstDirect: 充值本身不会交易或预约。创建者核对余额后，点击“检查余额并启动”执行首轮，再只预约下一轮。
zh.errors.targetToken: 请输入有效的目标代币合约地址。
zh.errors.loadTokenFirst: 请先加载有效 CA，确保按正确精度填写代币数量。
zh.errors.priceFloor: 暂时无法读取这个 CA 的 Flap 报价，因此不能创建回购任务。请确认代币已在 Flap 市场可报价。
zh.errors.targetLookup: 无法将这个 CA 读取为代币。
zh.errors.amount: 请输入有效的正数数量。
zh.errors.interval: 执行间隔至少为 1 分钟。
zh.errors.retainWallet: 请输入有效的留存钱包地址。
zh.errors.fixedRecipients: 请输入 1 到 5 个互不重复的有效地址。
zh.errors.randomHolders: 请输入 1 到 20 的整数。
zh.errors.funding: 请输入有效的 BNB 充值数量。
zh.errors.withdraw: 请输入有效的未使用 BNB 数量。
zh.errors.startFunds: 只有任务创建者可以启动，余额还必须足够支付首轮回购和一次性启动费。
zh.errors.factoryRead: 无法读取 Factory 的任务列表。请确认 Mini App 已使用当前网络上的新版 Factory。
zh.errors.simulation: 交易预检查失败。请检查任务状态、BNB 数量和代币 CA。
zh.errors.tx: 交易失败。请检查钱包确认和链上任务状态。
zh.messages.taskFunded: BNB 已充值到该代币的共享 Vault。
zh.messages.withdrawn: 未使用 BNB 已提取。
zh.messages.taskClosed: 操作已关闭。共享 Vault 余额仍可供其他操作使用，创建者也可提取。
zh.messages.checked: 已检查任务余额并重试预约。
zh.messages.started: 首轮回购已执行；若余额足够，已预约下一轮。
